message:
Now I understand the FCI format. The FCI response needs to start with tag `0x62` (ISO7816_TAG_FCI) or `0x62` (FCP), followed by TLV data. The file size is encoded in tag `0x80` or `0x81`.

Let me check the ISO7816_TAG_FCI value.

<｜｜DSML｜｜parameter=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/opensc && grep -n "ISO7816_TAG_FCI\|ISO7816_TAG_FCP" src/libopensc/iso7816.h src/libopensc/*.h 2>/dev/null | head -10</｜｜DSML｜｜parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜parameter>
